description: Send a feature request, problem report, or general feedback to the private ClearPolicy product team inbox. Use only when the user asks to send feedback or approves the exact message you propose. Do not send automatically when a tool is missing. Send only the feedback, without chat history, personal information, document content, or diagnostics. Returns a receipt, not a support ticket.

message.description: The feedback the user wants ClearPolicy staff to receive.

tool_name.description: Name of the affected connector tool, if relevant.
